verdict.rationale: ReadMe's first-party Versions docs say it supports maintaining more than one version of your docs, with version settings and a reader-facing dropdown for switching versions on the site. That covers the core of the story. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of per-API-version publishing mechanics (e.g., tying OpenAPI definitions to versions), explicit evidence of per-product versioning, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I publish versioned documentation per product or API version, and readers switch versions from the site

citations.quote: Maintaining multiple versions of your documentation is critical for many different technical products.
Maintain more than one version of your docs, covering version settings, the reader-facing dropdown, and common use cases.
